purpose: Pins for everything the pipeline pulls from outside this repository, so an upstream change is detected instead of silently changing a number. Three kinds of pin: (1) revision -- the Hugging Face commit SHA a download is resolved at; (2) sha256 -- the digest of a file the pipeline downloads; (3) derived_fingerprints -- the digest of a committed file that the pipeline itself derived from an external dataset, which is the only pin that is tied to the run of record rather than to a later observation. scripts/check_external_artifacts.py verifies (3) offline; qquilt.external applies (1) and re-checks (3) when the pipeline rebuilds a corpus; scripts/claim_from_checkpoint.sh verifies (2).
revision_pin_caveat: The campaign did not record a revision SHA at run time; qquilt.data/groups/utility/train called load_dataset/from_pretrained by id only. The revisions below are the repository heads as observed on 2026-08-22. Each one's lastModified predates the run of record, so no upstream write happened between the campaign and the pin, and the head is the revision the campaign resolved. They are recorded as a forward pin -- from here on the pipeline asks for these revisions by name -- not as a certificate recovered from the original runs. The derived fingerprints are the check that is anchored in the run of record.

derived_fingerprints.why_it_pins: The file is 50 emails drawn by random.Random(43).sample() from the rows NOT in the seeded 3000-email training sample, so its content depends on the dataset's row count AND on the text of the selected rows. Any upstream edit, addition or reordering changes the digest.
The file is the first 50 non-empty rows of the test split in dataset order, so an upstream edit to any of them, or to the rows before them, changes the digest.

The 50 G2 control passages, with the source row index of each one in its `source` field, so the digest covers both the dataset's row count and the text of those rows. The generation seed is NOT recorded in the file or beside it, so this entry is a fingerprint to compare against by hand, not one the pipeline can rebuild and re-check on its own.
Listed for completeness: the committed G3 is the seed-deterministic synthetic fallback, generated locally, so it pins no upstream source. Its digest still catches a change in the generator itself.
